dedupe_keys.name: ilr luxembourg network deployment survey rgdr 2g 4g and 5g maximum speed coverage and fixed vhcn by commune with semiannual telecom statistics

description: The Luxembourg Institute of Regulation keeps the Relevé géographique du déploiement des réseaux (RGDR), the central record of fixed and mobile public network coverage in Luxembourg under article 26 of the law of 17 December 2021 on electronic communications networks. It publishes extracts as open data twice a year. The 2026 extracts give maximum available mobile speed coverage for 2G, 4G and 5G as large CSV files of about 27, 21 and 19 MB, updated in August 2026, and a small file of very high capacity network coverage by commune, split between DOCSIS cable and fibre. Coverage maps and methods are explained on the regulator's site, and the maps supported the national ultra high speed network strategy for 2021 to 2025. A separate dataset carries the semiannual telecom statistics workbook, which follows the national electronic communications market (subscriptions, traffic and revenue), last issued in June 2026. Coverage: Luxembourg, by map grid or point and by commune. Format and access: CSV and XLSX on data.public.lu, free under CC BY. Caveats: coverage is operator-declared; files are updated at different times and the regulator warns that details may not match between them; grid resolution and columns were not checked. Simulation uses: mobile speed and fixed VHCN coverage baselines for Luxembourg service models. Related records: the checkmynet.lu measurements give crowdsourced speeds; the BIPT data portal and the Digital Decade DESI indicators give neighbouring and EU views.
name: ILR Luxembourg network deployment survey (RGDR): 2G, 4G and 5G maximum speed coverage and fixed VHCN by commune, with semiannual telecom statistics
notes: udata API read on 2026-09-26 (descriptions, resources, sizes, dates, licence). Files were not downloaded. The contents of the statistics workbook are inferred from its description.
